reuse.why: Extends the existing shared pre-link guard used by all six providers and extracts the unlinkAccount field-clearing into clearBankLink, reused by both unlink and takeover.

duplication.why: The 'unlinked account' shape now lives in one helper shared with unlinkAccount instead of being copied; per-provider edits are only the flag pass-through.

placement.why: Logic lives in the accounts server module beside the guard, though a mutation (unlinking the holder) now happens inside what was a validation step, before the new link is written.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the extracted helper and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean and centralised; the guard-that-mutates (prepareBankAccountLink) slightly blurs check vs action ordering but is clearly named.
